title: David Lawant: Seeing “Very Strong Inflow” for Bitcoin at $60k
summary: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine David Lawant: Seeing “Very Strong Inflow” for Bitcoin at $60k David Lawant, Head of Research at Anchorage Digital, joins BMTV to break down what's really driving Bitcoin's sell-off and who's doing the selling.
